results.title: Recess, college style: UMass Outing Club gives hundreds of students chance to get outside and play - Amherst Bulletin
results.content: The hike on Mount Abraham was one of many trips the Outdoor Adventure Sports Club, or simply the Outing Club, runs each week. It’s one of the largest clubs at the University of Massachusetts Amherst, with around 600 active members. The club runs trips almost every day, taking students hiking, backpacking, canoeing, kayaking, rafting, skiing, caving and rock climbing. [...] “I went to the club fair, like, the first week of school,” recounts said Thomas Oberlander, another UMass junior. “I had been looking for an outdoor-focused club when I was coming into school because it’s something I really enjoy, and the Outing Club members were carrying a canoe around the student union room. And I was like, immediately, ‘That’s the club for me,’” said Oberlander, who is now the club’s president. [...] AMHERST — As they navigated the steep and rocky terrain of Mount Abraham, members of the UMass Amherst Outing Club struggled together as they carried a 150-pound dog down the mountain on a makeshift stretcher of blankets.

results.title: UMass Amherst Alumni - Amherst, MA - UMOC Centennial Celebration
results.content: Please join us for the fall kickoff event of the centennial year of the University of Massachusetts Outing Club (UMOC). Celebrate the club’s unique and lasting impact to the UMass community while connecting with fellow alumni, students, and staff over a tasty southwestern dinner. [...] Since 1922, UMOC has engaged students in the outdoors and given respite to those weary of the rigors of academia. From the depths of curious caverns to the windy heights of lofty summits, from the vibrant forests to the driest sandiest deserts, UMOC has brought people together through wide ranging pursuits of fun and fellowship in the outdoors. The bonds forged on these trips span generations, and many alumni are still in contact with each other and new members of the club. UMOC has provided an [...] has provided an unparalleled chance to experience the outdoors with weekly trips and affordable gear rentals. Members have used the leadership skills they acquired in the club to create lasting environmental change in their communities.

Today, the UMass Club serves as the University’s flagship club, bringing together a vibrant and diverse community in the heart of Boston. [...] Established in 2005, the UMass Club was created as a gathering place for alumni, friends, and supporters of the University of Massachusetts—reflecting its role as a public institution open to all. Originally located in Boston’s Financial District, the Club relocated to One Beacon Street in 2015, expanding its presence and deepening its connection to the city. [...] University of Massachusetts

# UMass Outing Club

 Our Instagram!

## What Is UMOC?

The UMass Amherst Outing Club (UMOC) Is a student-run club that organizes trips in the great outdoors! Anything from short front country hikes to 3 day whitewater trips 6 hours off-campus. We have it all!

## How Do I Join?

All you have to do is make your own account on TeamApp (listed in our socials), search “UMOC” in the organizations tab, and join!
